package.name: Noir Ink Pro
package.description: Monochrome illustration brushes: a wet sumi brush with real hair splay, a dry crosshatch comb, flung splatter, an ink wash that dries with a ring, and a nib that blots when it lands.
package.author: HereLiesAz

package.name: Painterly Pro
package.description: One standout in each medium: heavy oil that leaves real paint height, a matte gouache flat, compressed charcoal that side-shades with tilt, a watercolour bloom with a cauliflower edge, and an impasto knife.
package.author: HereLiesAz

package.name: Print Shop Pro
package.description: Print-room texture without the press: a halftone screen locked to the canvas, riso grain that mixes your two colours, a screenprint squeegee pull, a stipple pen and a linocut gouge.
package.author: HereLiesAz

package.name: Street & Mural Pro
package.description: Five wall brushes tuned for real can and marker control: a feathered fat cap that pools where you linger, a mop marker that blots on touchdown, torn wheat-paste, a sprayed stencil edge and a nap roller with lap marks.
package.author: HereLiesAz

package.name: Wild Growth Pro
package.description: Nature scatter brushes that paint in two colours at once: tumbling leaves, grass tufts, streaked bark, piled cloud puffs and slanting rain.
package.author: HereLiesAz
